holes_found.description: Non-breaking space (U+00A0) appears between 'al.' and '(2001)' in the anchor text 'Mansinha et al. (2001)'. EXP-603-P6 specified a regular space (U+0020). Could be an intentional editorial choice (prevents line-break orphaning of 'et al.' from its date) but deviates from the EXP spec.
holes_found.proposed_fix: Optional: replace U+00A0 with U+0020 in the anchor text for character consistency. No functional impact.
